picks.headline: Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 for real-time world simulation
picks.why: DeepMind's latest world model enables real-time, highly realistic interactive world generation and environment simulation.
picks.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation

picks.headline: NVIDIA CUDA 13.4 brings memory-enforced GPU sharing to Kubernetes
picks.why: Hard memory limits prevent out-of-memory crashes when sharing GPUs across fractional Kubernetes AI workloads.
picks.title: Memory-Enforced GPU Sharing in Kubernetes with NVIDIA CUDA 13.4

picks.headline: Log-To-Leak vulnerability exploits Model Context Protocol tool descriptions
picks.why: Demonstrates how prompt injection inside MCP tool descriptions can silently exfiltrate data via unauthorized logging calls.
picks.title: Log-To-Leak: Prompt Injection Attacks on Tool-Using LLM Agents via the Model Context Protocol

picks.headline: Liquid AI releases LFM3 framework for custom multimodal models
picks.why: Enables building specialized, context-aware visual and text models tailored to proprietary enterprise datasets.
picks.title: Build specialized multimodal models with LFM3

picks.headline: Google Project Zero benchmarks BigSleep LLM against Fuzzilli on V8
picks.why: Provides six months of empirical data comparing LLM bug-finding capabilities directly against state-of-the-art engine fuzzers.
picks.title: Fuzzers vs. AI: Comparing Fuzzilli and BigSleep on JavaScript Engines

picks.headline: Google TPUs expand to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in multicloud partnership
picks.why: Allows enterprise infrastructure teams to run Google Cloud TPU workloads directly within OCI environments.
picks.title: Bringing Google TPUs to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure

picks.headline: Anthropic offers 40% discount on Claude products for government users
picks.why: Expands government adoption of Claude across direct and cloud purchasing routes via an updated GSA agreement.
picks.title: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government

papers.headline: MuonGS adds Gram-Schmidt projection to Muon for faster pretraining
papers.why: Removes radial update components to relax weight-norm control, enabling faster effective learning rate growth during LLM pretraining.
papers.title: MuonGS: Pretraining LLMs with Relaxed Weight-Norm Control

papers.headline: SPOT enables lossless speculative decoding for diffusion language models
papers.why: Uses a lightweight 0.62M parameter commit-order model to speed up diffusion LLM decoding throughput by up to 3.4x.
papers.title: On the SPOT: Enhancing Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Language Models via Commit-Order Prediction

papers.headline: Memory Tax study shows dedicated agent memory often underperforms RAG
papers.why: Reveals that specialized agent memory overhead frequently degrades performance compared to naive RAG baselines.
papers.title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
